evidence.reason: `discard()` writes the cleanup warning directly to stderr on an OSError. Because `download()` and `fetch_*()` call `discard()` inside their failure paths, that warning can be emitted before `main()` handles the primary exception. In machine mode (`--json`), the current contract requires stderr to stay empty and any error object to go to stdout, so this direct print bypasses the machine-mode output path.
